title: December 2024: MLA citations, IB rubrics, and smarter AI!
summary: Easily cite AI in MLA, Chicago, or APA. Plus, Flint now generates IB rubrics and is significantly better at following teacher-provided instructions.
body_markdown:
Flint now does a significantly better job of sticking to the helpfulness level and rules for a given activity. This is largely because we’ve switched the AI model powering Flint from OpenAI’s GPT-4o to Anthropic’s Claude 3.5 Sonnet.


To read more updates about Flint, check out our[press](https://flintk12.com/) page.
